notes.title: 21/4/4 Update
notes.content:
1. After much consideration, we decided to ease the difficulty in Babymode.
- Line length has been increased considerably in Babymode.
- In Babymode, there is now a rare chance that our friend 'Kiria' will teleport you to the location before it fell.

[b]2. Shortcuts existed in the previous gas dragon section and windy section.[/b]
This part was a difficult route designed with the intention of shortening the time, but it turned out to be easier than expected.
A lot of people passed the gas dragon section.
We would like to correct this part.

- The shortcut described above has now been corrected to appear after the 'falling dragon' section.
- Weakened the wind strength in the windy section.
- Adjusted the duration of strong winds in the windy section to be shorter.

[b]3. Reset Ranking[/b]
Since there are important map modifications above, we decided to proceed with the average clearing time taken into account.
Rankings prior to this update are stored in the community.

Please understand that it was translated with a translator. Thank you.

notes.title: 2018/05/17 Patch
notes.content:
- 10 achievements have been added.

Because of my lack of ability, I would like to have had since the day of game release. People who are already clear and have collected all the artifacts will be angry, but what can I do? Life is a repetition of agony. If you want to achievement, you can turn this painful game back on.

- Added mouse lock option. Now you can unlock your mouse on the screen or keep it lock.

- Users who collect all artifacts and now wear sunglasses can now change whether or not they wear sunglasses in their options.

notes.title: 2018/04/12 patch
notes.content:
- It makes one slippery footboard flat and now does not slip well.

- The length of the trunk is slightly increased at the entrance of the gap, so you can see without jumping.

- The wind speed is slightly stronger. However, the wind intensity in the final section weakened.

- Slightly reduced the size of the big void fragments at the foot of the bridge and the next step.

- Slightly reduced the size of the small void fragments in the final section.

- The speed of the blue dragon caught when entering the final section has increased.

- The frequency of launch of Meteor in the last section has changed.
Randomly between 5 and 8 seconds => 6.75 seconds



I forgot the most important thing.

-Ria's crying cooldown has been reduced from 8 seconds to 3 seconds.

※A void fragment is a black object with red eyes.

notes.title: 2018/04/08 patch
notes.content:
I prevented the mouse from leaving the entire screen when using a dual monitor. I have also made a window mode, but I did not have a perfect prevention because of lack of ability.

This game is really difficult, and there is no mercy.
If you are a strong-willed person, it's worth the challenge, but I hope your health will not be hurt by this trivial game.
